maddeler.e:
أصطحب (form VIII)
# أَصْطَحِبُ (ʔaṣṭaḥibu) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.ħi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# أُصْطَحَبُ (ʔuṣṭaḥabu) /ʔusˤ.tˤa.ħa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# أَصْطَحِبَ (ʔaṣṭaḥiba) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.ħi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# أُصْطَحَبَ (ʔuṣṭaḥaba) /ʔus
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
